text:
The request attached from
17 June.. The bot answers. They said: 1st I should pay 500 THB just for get acknowledged about the price. 2nd, I should wait a month to get this paid consultation..
Crazy..

Previously, I visited the clinic with another question, I was needed specific procedure on the eyelid, it’s not difficult procedure.. I asked the receptionist about costs and possibility -- he said I need show it to the doctor first.. I agreed.. Next, the doctor looked on the eyelid for 10 seconds.. And said “I cannot dfix it, go to another clinic”..
They charged 250 THB for this.. Crazy service..
Moreover, I fix this problem without surgery by myself -- I just used warm compress on eyelid and the problem has been solved at all within a few weeks.. The doctor in clinic even didn’t say about this option..😵‍💫

Customer should pay 250-500 THB to get acknowledge that the clinic can’t provide the procedure he needs.

The procedure (wart removal) requested today I guess the simple cream from pharmacy should be also enough.. It was really small and I showed it via chat to manager-bot.

I don’t recommend this place, don’t waste your time.
